meta_title: Picker Lock Locksmith | Emergency Locksmith Manchester
meta_description: Picker Lock Locksmith Manchester provides 24/7 emergency lockout services, lock repairs, and key cutting. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_subhead: Picker Lock arrives fast across Manchester. No call-out charge if we can't help.
services_subhead: From urgent lockouts to lock repairs and key cutting, we handle residential and commercial lock emergencies round the clock.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, flat, or office? We'll get you back inside fast without forcing damage. Available any time, day or night.

services.title: Car Lockouts
services.desc: Broken key in the ignition or locked keys in the boot? We specialise in non-destructive car unlocking and can cut replacement keys on-site.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Broken lock mechanisms, damaged cylinders, or worn handles? We repair or replace with quality locks fitted properly and tested.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Need a spare key quickly? We cut keys for houses, cars, and businesses while you wait. Laser-cut and traditional keys available.

services.title: Burst Lock & Forced Entry
services.desc: If a lock's been forced or is stuck solid, we'll remove and replace it with minimal damage to your door or frame.

services.title: Commercial Lock Services
services.desc: Workplace lockouts, master key systems, and access control issues? We handle commercial emergencies with discretion and speed.

about_pullquote: I started Picker Lock because I was tired of seeing people ripped off in emergencies.
about_para_1: Picker Lock was founded to bring honest, fast locksmith help to Manchester residents and businesses. With over a decade in the trade, we've built our reputation on arriving quickly, charging fairly, and never forcing unnecessary damage to your property.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we answer the phone 24/7, quote upfront, and carry most locks and keys on the van. We're not the cheapest — but we're the fastest and most straightforward.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Picker Lock

reviews.text: Locked myself out of the house at 11pm on a Sunday and panicked. Called Picker Lock and the guy was with me in 40 minutes. He got the door open without any damage and charged exactly what he'd quoted. Absolute lifesaver. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: Car keys snapped off in the lock outside the pub. Thought it was going to cost me hundreds. Picker Lock came out, extracted the broken bit, and cut me a new key on the spot. Fair price, friendly bloke, job done in 30 minutes. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: We had a commercial lockout at our gym on a Friday evening. Called at the last minute and they turned up in under an hour. Professional, quick, and didn't treat us like we were stupid for losing the key. Highly recommend for business owners.
reviews.author: Mike T.

address_sub: Serving all of Manchester and surrounding areas — 24/7 emergency response
opening_hours_sub: Emergency line always open — no unsociable hour surcharge
emergency_banner_text: Locked out right now? We aim to be with you in under an hour. Call us —
footer_description: Picker Lock is Manchester's trusted 24/7 emergency locksmith. Fast response, fair prices, no damage.
